system.description: While you are gaining the benefits of this generalization, when you would force a creature to make a saving throw with a Maneuver, item, or feature you use, you can spend 1 Bonus Action. When you do, the affected creature cannot gain bonuses to their saving throw as a result of jutsu they cast. Also, when making a contested check with a hostile creature, you can spend 1 Superiority Die to add the result to your check.

activities.label: Seize: add to a contested check

roll.note: Add the Superiority Die to your contested check.
